Question
========
How do universal basic services (UBS) differ from a universal basic income (UBI)?

Answerlist
----------
* UBS provides essential services collectively, while UBI pays cash to individuals
* UBS is only for the poorest
* UBS pays a higher cash amount than UBI
* They are the same

Solution
========
UBS guarantees access to housing, health, education, care, mobility, and digital access as rights, counteracting commodification.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
